title: Undergraduate Programs
body:
B.A. (Bachelor of Arts) - 3 Years

Our B.A. program provides a comprehensive foundation in the humanities and social sciences. Students can specialize in subjects such as Political Science, History, Geography, and Literature. This program is designed to develop critical thinking and communication skills, preparing graduates for success in Civil Services, Journalism, and Education.

B.Sc. (Bachelor of Science) - 3 Years

The B.Sc. program offers specialized tracks in both the Biology and Mathematics groups. Equipped with modern laboratory facilities, students gain hands-on experience in Physics, Chemistry, Botany, and Zoology. The curriculum emphasizes scientific inquiry and technical proficiency, paving the way for careers in research, healthcare, and technology.

B.Com. (Bachelor of Commerce) - 3 Years

The B.Com. program focuses on the core principles of business, finance, and trade. Students master essential disciplines including Accountancy, Business Administration, and Economic Administration (EAFM). By bridging the gap between theory and industry practice, we prepare our students for professional roles in Banking, Chartered Accountancy, and Corporate Management.
